mapper.insert: insert ignore into im_message_mention (message_id, mention_type, target_id) values (#{messageId}, #{type}, #{targetId})
insert ignore into im_message_ref (message_id, conversation_id, reply_to_id, thread_root_id) values (#{messageId}, #{conversationId}, #{replyToId}, #{threadRootId})
mapper.select: select message_id as messageId, conversation_id as conversationId, reply_to_id as replyToId, thread_root_id as threadRootId from im_message_ref where message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into im_message_reaction (message_id, member_id, emoji, conversation_id) values (#{messageId}, #{memberId}, #{emoji}, #{conversationId})
mapper.delete: delete from im_message_reaction where message_id = #{messageId} and member_id = #{memberId} and emoji = #{emoji}
mapper.select: select count(*) from im_message_reaction where message_id = #{messageId} and member_id = #{memberId}
select message_id as messageId, emoji, count(*) as total, max(case when member_id = #{viewer} then 1 else 0 end) as mine from im_message_reaction where message_id in #{i} group by message_id, emoji
